prompt: Final photorealistic 3D render of a 1999 Nissan Skyline GT-R R34 coupe, early first-year model, in Bayside Blue metallic paint. Three-quarter front view from a slightly low camera, 35mm lens, car fills the frame. Clean studio environment: seamless dark charcoal backdrop, large overhead softbox creating long soft highlight bands along the roofline, bonnet and doors, glossy floor with a subtle reflection. Physically based rendering look: accurate metallic clear-coat paint with fine flake, polished aluminium five-spoke wheels with visible brake calipers behind, realistic tire sidewalls, glass with faint reflections, crisp panel gaps, clean HDRI reflections. Accurate R34 details: twin rectangular headlamps, hood vents on the bonnet, large rear wing, flared arches, side skirts, front lip. No people, no text, no logos, no watermark.
